# Smarter.Poker

> The ultimate poker platform for GTO training, live venue discovery, bankroll tracking, social connection, and community.

## About

Smarter.Poker is a comprehensive poker ecosystem with 13+ integrated "orbs" (modules) designed to make poker players smarter, more connected, and more profitable. The platform is free to use with optional VIP features.

## Core Features

### GTO Training Engine
Interactive poker training with 100+ scenario-based games covering MTT, Cash, Spins & SNGs, Mental Game, and Advanced Theory. Powered by AI coaching from Jarvis, the tactical intelligence layer.

### Poker Near Me
Live poker room and venue finder with real-time game information, tournament schedules, and interactive maps covering venues across the United States.

### Bankroll Manager
Professional-grade financial tracking for poker players. Track sessions, analyze leaks, monitor ROI, and visualize trends with detailed analytics and variance analysis.

### Poker Trivia
Test and expand poker knowledge with multiple game modes: Endless, Survival, Time Attack, Mixed, PvP, and Tournaments. Features leaderboards, achievements, and streak tracking.

### Diamond Store
Premium poker merchandise and gear marketplace with cart, wishlist, and order management.

### Club Arena
Private online poker clubs with real-time gameplay, tournaments, hand histories, player stats, leaderboards, and club management.

### Club Commander
Enterprise poker room management suite for live venues with 62+ management tools including waitlist, tournaments, cashier, dealer rotation, floor management, analytics, and more.

### Social Hub
Full social platform with friends, messaging, social pages, reels, news feed, leaderboards, and community engagement features.

### Poker News
Aggregated poker news from multiple sources, updated hourly.

### Video Library
Curated poker video content library with watch history tracking and AI tactical analysis.

### Memory Games
Poker-themed cognitive training games to improve memory and pattern recognition.

### Diamond Arcade
Arcade-style poker games with achievements, leaderboards, and prize tracking.

### Events Calendar
Poker tournament and event calendar with live updates.

## AI Features

- **Jarvis**: Elite tactical GTO intelligence layer providing solver-grade analysis
- **Geeves**: Robot butler-style live help assistant for user support
- **Proactive Help**: Context-aware assistance suggestions throughout the platform

## Technical Details

- **URL**: https://smarter.poker
- **Platform**: Web application (progressive web app)
- **Framework**: Next.js (World Hub), React + Vite (Club Arena)
- **Pricing**: Free with optional VIP subscription
